notes: Background: Large regional healthcare payer evaluating private VPC deployment for clinical summarization and patient support chat. Data is PHI/PII — must meet strict residency and audit requirements.

Encryption in transit: Orion requires mTLS between their VPC and Redwood ingress endpoints. Prefer TLS 1.3, mutual client certs with short TTL. They asked for cert rotation cadence and automated rotation options.

mTLS specifics discussed: Redwood to provide recommendations for client cert rotation (recommended 90 days default), support for customer-managed certificates (BYOCert) and automated ACME-style renewal if desired.
Ingress / egress: All egress must be controllable; they require explicit IP allowlist and IPSec layer for legacy VPNs. Need diagram showing where mTLS terminates (edge vs inside control plane).

Encryption at rest: Disk and object storage must use AES-256-GCM. They prefer envelope encryption with customer-managed keys in AWS KMS (BYOK) and want optional HSM (FIPS 140-2/140-3) attestations for critical keys.

KMS / Key rotation: Orion requires monthly rotation policy for model-enterprise keys, ability to trigger immediate rotation, and documented key rotation playbook. They asked if Redwood supports separate keys per workspace/tenant.

BYOK / HSM options: Legal + Infosec flagged need for HSM-backed keys for long-term custody of master keys. Redwood to confirm support for AWS CloudHSM / Azure Dedicated HSM and provide attestation docs.

Secrets management: Recommended integration path is HashiCorp Vault or cloud-native KMS; secrets delivered via VPC endpoint with short-lived AWS STS credentials. Orion wants a sample Vault -> Redwood connector flow and rotation automation notes.

Audit logging: Must forward immutable request/response metadata (not payload) to Orion SIEM (Splunk/CloudWatch) with tamper-evident delivery. Retention requested 5+ years; Redwood to outline storage tiering and export process.
Data residency: All inference payloads and logs for the account must remain in us-east-1. Redwood to confirm control plane metadata residency and redact controls for telemetry.

POC scope / success metrics: 1) Demonstrate mTLS handshake with customer cert + rotation; 2) BYOK key creation & rotation demonstration; 3) Audit log forwarding to Splunk with expected fields; 4) Latency SLO: p50 < 120ms for chat, throughput 60 req/s for summarization job.
Quotes from calls: 'We need to prove key custody and rotation — if we can't get HSM attestation it's a non-starter', — Orion Infosec (paraphrase).
Action items assigned: SE Maya to produce KMS integration design + rotation playbook (due 2026-03-12). AE Jordan to loop Legal on BYOK draft. CSM Diego to coordinate log forwarding POC schedule.

Risks: If Redwood cannot provide HSM attestation + long-term immutable audit logs, procurement will pause. Cost sensitivity moderate — willing to pay premium for HSM-backed keys and extended retention.
